title: Irene Borg After the Game Signed Numbered 45/975 Framed Art Print Boy Baseball
conditionDescription: Frame finish has crackling and light wear at the corners - see photos. Print, signature and numbering are clean.
descriptionText:
Irene Borg - "After the Game" - Pencil Signed and Numbered Limited Edition Print, Framed

You will receive the exact piece pictured. These are photos of the actual item, not stock images.

Details:
- Artist: Irene Borg
- Title: "After the Game" (titled in pencil below the image)
- Hand-numbered 45/975 and pencil-signed by the artist
- Image: a young boy in blue overalls and a blue hat holding a baseball glove and bat, standing in a garden of flowers, in Borg's soft impressionist style
- Double-matted in pink and sage green, under glass
- Ornate cream / antique white carved-style frame with floral corner accents
- Frame measures approximately 24 x 20 inches
- Paper backing with hanging wire

Condition: Used / pre-owned. The frame finish shows crackling (craquelure) and light wear, most visible at the corners - please see the close-up photos. The print, signature and numbering are clean. Please review all photos closely; they are the best description of condition.
